newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Italian navy ship runs aground off Albanian coast.
newsitem.headline: Italian navy ship runs aground off Albanian coast.

text.p: An Italian navy ship in a multinational security mission to Albania ran aground in stormy seas off the coast of the rebel-held city of Vlore on Tuesday, an Italian military spokesman said.
"The Vittorio Veneto got stuck in stormy seas," Lieutenant Colonel Gianfranco Scalas, military spokesman of the Italian-led multinational mission to Albania, told Reuters.
Scalas said the ship ran aground on the sandy bottom near Vlore port in a strong gale.
Witnesses said they saw two tugs and three Italian navy vessels near the Vittorio Veneto about 500 metres (yards) from the shore.
A storm lashed Vlore from the late afternoon on Monday throughout the night.

The Vittorio Veneto belongs to an eight-nation multinational security mission to protect humanitarian aid deliveries in the anarchic Balkan state. Some 160 Italian troops disembarked from Italian navy ships off Vlore on Monday.
